description: Run the Consensus Hardening Protocol R0 gate on a proposed decision: is it solvable, scoped, valid, and worth making at all? Any FATAL answer returns HALT — stop and reframe before doing the work.

solvable.description: Can this problem actually be solved?

valid.description: Is the current state accurately understood?

worth_it.description: Do the stakes justify the work?

name: decision_gate
